scope: Proof of concept of the candidate design docs/APP-FRAMES.md: business app UIs in per-installation cross-origin frames, platform screens same-page. Isolated tools only; no production state, service, container or database was changed.

decisions.branch: poc/app-frames in a separate worktree (/projects/miy-v2-app-frames) so the shared checkout and its production state stay on main
decisions.adoption: D1 is the user's decision from these results

limitations: P3 is one site: no process isolation guarantee and frames share the host cookie jar (credentials are never cookies).
P2 frame-src cannot name only app hosts (whole-label wildcard); P3 uses the host port wildcard. Platform documents keep frame-ancestors 'none'.
Each installation also takes a Docker network; the host's address pools bound how many apps one host runs, independent of frames.
